texts:
Before an AI agent asks a GPU to build a chair, it can check whether one already exists. The find-3d-assets skill searches more than 3,500 free assets first: CC0 props, rigged characters and motion clips, one GET, no account, no API key.

A hit is a finished GLB with its license and a direct URL. Only when nothing fits does generate-3d-model write a new textured model from a sentence, on the free lane.

The order is the point. An existing asset is instant where a generation is GPU minutes, so the skill's own description tells the agent to look here before it generates.

The skills install as a Claude Code plugin, a project folder or a Claude project: three.ws/docs/agent-skills
